title: [GMCP 203.044.05] Interoperability and quality: Inspector, debugger, record/replay, mocks, and test laboratory
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-044-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: An operator can inspect negotiated capabilities, schemas, calls, subscriptions, tasks and traces; validate a server; replay a redacted deterministic transcript; inject latency/faults; and generate configurable mock clients or servers from contracts. Sensitive fields are removed before persistence, replay cannot perform side effects by default, formats are versioned, and CLI/TUI plus official Inspector workflows agree. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
